purpose: gold-side reference fixture; never enters model context

claims.paraphrase: NATO created to secure peace/stability in Europe after WWII
claims.rationale: Matches 1949 treaty's stated purpose; omits Soviet-containment motive (simplification, not error).

claims.paraphrase: Only president to cut the deficit by $1T+ in a single year
claims.rationale: Forward-looking when spoken; realized (FY2022 deficit $1.375T, −$1.40T y/y; below half of FY2020 $3.132T). But CBO Feb-2021 pre-ARP baseline projected ~$1.06T FY2022 deficit — decline driven by expiring pandemic outlays, not enacted policy. 'Only president ever' trivially true.

evidence.source: Treasury/OMB Final Monthly Treasury Statement FY2022 (Oct 2022)
CBO, The Budget and Economic Outlook: 2021–2031 (Feb 2021)

claims.rationale: CDC tracker ~75% adults fully vaccinated late Feb 2022; new admissions down ~77% measured from Jan 2022 Omicron peak (favorable baseline choice).

claims.paraphrase: US shared intel in advance of Putin's false justification for invasion
claims.rationale: Declassified false-flag warnings (Feb 3, 2022) and Blinken UN Security Council briefing (Feb 17, 2022) preceded an invasion matching the described pretext script.

claims.paraphrase: Economy grew 5.7% last year, strongest in ~40 years
claims.rationale: BEA estimate at utterance (+5.7%, fastest since 1984's +7.2%). Later BEA revisions raised 2021 to ~6.2%, strengthening the claim.

evidence.source: BEA GDP releases: Q4-2021 advance (Jan 2022) + subsequent annual revisions

claims.paraphrase: US infrastructure ranked 13th in the world
claims.rationale: WEF Global Competitiveness Report 2019 infrastructure pillar ranks US 13th; last edition with rankings, so 3 years stale at utterance.

evidence.source: WEF Global Competitiveness Report 2019, US economy profile

claims.paraphrase: Law on books ~a century for taxpayer dollars supporting American jobs
claims.rationale: Buy American Act signed 1933-03-03 (41 U.S.C. §8301 ff.) = 89 years at utterance; 'almost a century' fair.
Peer-reviewed production estimates ~$2–6/vial (human vs analog); ≤$10 including delivery/margin. Generous upper bound; the 'up to 30x' multiple holds vs list prices, shrinks vs net.
uncertainty_drivers: list vs net price basis for the multiple

evidence.source: Gotham, Barber & Hill 2018, BMJ Global Health (insulin biosimilar production costs)

claims.paraphrase: Medicare should negotiate drug prices like VA does
claims.rationale: Premise true: VA negotiates via national formulary + statutory Federal Ceiling Prices (38 U.S.C. §8126); Part D then barred by MMA-2003 noninterference clause. 'Should' is advocacy, unfalsifiable. IRA (Aug 2022, post-utterance) later authorized limited Medicare negotiation.

claims.paraphrase: American Rescue Plan gave schools money for teachers and learning recovery
claims.rationale: ARP ESSER ≈ $122B K-12; ≥20% reserved for learning-loss recovery; staffing an allowable use.

evidence.source: ARP Act §2001 / ED ARP-ESSER guidance, ed.gov

claims.paraphrase: All Democrats voted against massive tax cuts
claims.rationale: H.R.1 (119th): Senate 51–50 (2025-07-01), House 218–214 (2025-07-03), zero Democratic ayes; five Republicans also voted no. Adjacent superlative 'largest tax cuts in American history' is false (1981 ERTA larger as %GDP) — outside this atom.

Component A (superlative): FALSE — June 2022 peak 9.1% CPI was highest since Nov 1981; US record is 23.7% for 12 months ending June 1920 (BLS). Component B ($34,000): INFERENCE — consistent with JEC-Republicans cumulative-cost tracker lineage ($27,950 through Jul 2024, ~$29,000 by Aug 2024); omits that same-period income gains exceeded cost increases (JEC-Democrats: ~$35,390 added wages; Census/Moody's corroborate).

claims.paraphrase: Thomas Jefferson drew his last breath (July 4, 1826)
claims.rationale: Jefferson died 1826-07-04 at Monticello, the Declaration's 50th anniversary; Adams died the same day. Speech arithmetic vs ~1926-born centenarian guests consistent.

evidence.source: Monticello.org / Library of Congress historical record

claims.paraphrase: One drug cost Catherine $4,000 to purchase
claims.rationale: White-House-selected guest (Catherine Rayner, IVF drug, $4,000 → under $500 via TrumpRx). Directionally plausible: fertility drugs often uninsured are among the site's few genuine deals; but ≥18 of 43 listed drugs have cheaper generics elsewhere, and surrounding 'highest→lowest in the world' framing is misleading.

claims.paraphrase: Both Dominican Americans grew up on streets they later patrolled as officers
claims.rationale: MISATTRIBUTED: absent from Trump 2026 transcript; verbatim in Biden 2022 SOTU re Officers Wilbert Mora (27) and Jason Rivera (22), NYPD, killed responding to a 911 call. Content substantially true as characterization (both Dominican-American, NYC-raised, Upper Manhattan beats). Correct metadata: speaker=Biden, utterance_date=2022-03-01.
uncertainty_drivers: 'same streets' is mild rhetorical compression (Inwood vs Harlem for Rivera)
